title: UiElementState
description: ui.element-state@1: the small store an Element keeps for itself (counters, scores, lists, a wheel's entries), as Live broadcasts it to everyone watching and as a read returns it. CHANNEL and ELEMENT_ID name the element instance, REVISION grows by one with each accepted change so a late frame never overwrites a newer one, and VALUES is the store itself: at most 32 keys, each a boolean, a number, a short string or a list of those. It is state, not code: no objects, no markup, no URL and no account data, which keeps a shared element's state safe to render for every viewer.

values.description: The element's own store. A key is lower-case and 32 characters at most; a value is a boolean, a number, a string of 200 characters at most or a list of those.
